p2_b3.ocr: The data for Q3 2023 illustrates a notable change in revenue streams, with a significant uptick in domestic roaming, reported at $18M. This reflects a year-over-year analysis, where Q3 2022 showed a robust performance attributed to an increase in travel. The growth rate of 11.1% for domestic roaming indicates a positive trajectory, supported by new partnerships aimed at expanding service offerings. Furthermore, key players in the market are also adapting to these trends; for instance, Verizon's growth rate was reported as AT&T, highlighting competitive dynamics.

p2_b4.ocr: The overarching growth in the sector is underlined by an overall market share growth rate of 35%, which underscores the importance of strategic positioning in a rapidly evolving landscape. Additionally, the international roaming segment has demonstrated resilience with a growth rate of 25.0%, further emphasizing the demand for seamless connectivity across borders. As organizations navigate these trends, it will be essential to leverage data insights to enhance service delivery and customer satisfaction, ensuring they remain competitive in this vibrant market.
